label: coach of
definition: Person X coaches or has coached sports team or collegiate program Y.
scope_notes: Explicit coach descriptions or direct coaching qualify, including dismissed/former tenure. University/team shorthand may identify the program. Manager, president, player, spokesperson, generic employment or presence alone do not.

facts.reason: Stu Jackson is explicitly Knicks coach in possessive, compound and coach-of constructions; victory-role and other paths are supplementary.
Jim Calhoun is repeatedly coach at/of Connecticut and directly coaches it; team references support the program interpretation.
Joe Paterno is Penn State coach and begins as its coach, with football-team context fixing the program.
Jim Boeheim is explicitly coach at and of Syracuse, supported by team references; room/presence paths are extra meanings.
Mike Krzyzewski is Duke coach in several direct descriptions, with accompanying team references.
